#5736: PR #5786 merged (part, the ticket stays open). I timed a real takeover game. One game loop takes about 2 s; speed 4 needs 0.06 s. There are about 220 RCON calls per loop, and Gather.trunk/stump made the most (712 of 2400): after the takeover each chopped tree draws its trunk again, with one call per probe. These now go in one batch. takeover_check --trigger: the stock goes up OK; the town center trains and a bot builds still FAIL. Next: batch the other commands that need no answer (aoe stop, summon text_display, data get Pos in follow/positions), or a time-based tick with a test of the gather cycle.
